subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

New kid on the block

options.text: Savings set aside for future use.
Don't hurt anyone that helps you.
Someone new to the group or area.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"New kid on the block"** refers to a person who is new to a place, a profession, or a circumstance, and who may lack experience or familiarity compared to the others around them.
 
• **Someone new to the group or area:** This is the correct option. (समूह या क्षेत्र में नया व्यक्ति)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Someone new to the group or area'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Looking at the provided options:
 
 
• **Nonsense or meaningless speech:** "Nonsense or meaningless speech" refers to talk or statements that are senseless or devoid of meaning. (बकवास या अर्थहीन भाषण)
 
• **Savings set aside for future use: **It refers to the act of saving money for future needs.(भविष्य के उपयोग के लिए बचत)
 
• **Don't hurt anyone that helps you:** This is a general piece of moral advice, and it's not connected to the meaning of the idiom.(जो कोई आपकी मदद करता है, उसे चोट नहीं पहुंचाएँ)
 
 

3a:Tc22,

The correct answer is **'To leave someone without any support or purpose '.**
